name: Earth Landing & Atmosphere Foundation
earthLandingPolicy: Earth reuses the inherited atmospheric-rocky descent/touchdown/on-foot/takeoff lifecycle through the surface-support layer; the canonical SOL Earth body flags and physical state are not rewritten.
earthSurfacePolicy: Local Earth terrain is deterministic terrestrial presentation, not mapped geography/topography. Ground color/relief and ordinary fog are lightweight proxies; ecology, hydrology, clouds and global weather are deferred.
earthAtmospherePolicy: Surface sky uses the existing wavelength-dependent atmospheric-optics model driven by the SOL 101325 Pa reference atmosphere, real surface gravity, live Sun altitude/eclipses and shared celestial observer geometry.
earthAlbedoPolicy: The CC BY 4.0 Akshat Earth albedo remains lazy-loaded and is explicitly mapped north-up with glTF V orientation handled at the texture level. The supplied GLB geometry is not used.
flightNavigationPolicy: Newtonian gravity/integrator, ship dynamics, flight computer, FRAME/transit, SOL states, astronomical observer/eclipses, planetary rotation, landing transition and takeoff/orbit insertion remain inherited rather than redesigned.
mobileCachePolicy: All changed/reachable versioned module edges are stamped ue0105e for Safari/GitHub Pages cache isolation.
scope: Earth landing, Earth atmospheric/terrestrial presentation, and Earth albedo orientation correction only; no SKY SPAWN, real GIS terrain, global climate/weather, separate cloud layer or new physics.
